episodes.synopsis: Civilian Amuro Ray is forced to pilot a prototype Federation mobile suit when enemy Zeon mobile suits attack his home space colony .
episodes.title: Gundam Rising

episodes.synopsis: In order to evacuate Side Seven, Amuro Ray and the Gundam duel Char Aznable and his custom Zaku out in space.
episodes.title: Destroy Gundam!

episodes.synopsis: In order to improve their chances of eluding Char Aznable's pursuit of White Base, the crew has to vote whether to attack a Zeon supply ship or not.
episodes.title: Vote to Attack

episodes.synopsis: After arriving at a Federation asteroid military base, the White Base is confiscated and its crew are arrested for violating military protocol by allowing civilians to use top secret government property.
episodes.title: Escape From Luna II

episodes.synopsis: Bright Noa is instructed to take the White Base to a military base on Earth, but first they have to take on Char Aznable's forces near the atmospheric entry point.
episodes.title: Re-Entry to Earth

episodes.synopsis: White Base arrives on Zeon territory due to Char Aznable's strategy; Garma Zabi, eager to impress his sister Kycilia and his friend Char, decides to attack White Base.
episodes.title: Garma Strikes

episodes.synopsis: Amuro attempts to contact Federation forces by flying back into space with the Core Fighter.
episodes.title: The Core Fighter's Escape

episodes.synopsis: A cease fire is declared between Zeon and Federation forces when the refugees aboard White Base decide to jump ship.
episodes.title: Winds of War

episodes.synopsis: Amuro feels unwilling to pilot the Gundam anymore, while Garma Zabi is planning to personally lead an attack on White Base.
episodes.title: Fly, Gundam!

episodes.synopsis: Garma's task force consisting of Gaws pursue White Base to the now ruined city of New York.
episodes.title: Garma's Fate

episodes.synopsis: Icelina Esconbach asks a Zeon officer to lead a special mission to destroy White Base, responsible for the death of her boyfriend Garma.
episodes.title: Icelina - Love's Remains

episodes.synopsis: Gihren Zabi uses the death of his brother Garma as a rallying point for the Zeon cause while a new task force led by Ramba Ral and his Gouf mobile suit pursue White Base.
episodes.title: The Threat of Zeon

episodes.synopsis: Amuro Ray is reunited with his mother Kamaria when the crew of White Base coincidentally decides to rest near the place where he was born.
episodes.title: Coming Home

episodes.synopsis: Time is running out for Amuro when a small squadron of Zeon soldiers in hovering bikes plant time bombs all over the Gundam's frame.
episodes.title: Time, Be Still

episodes.synopsis: When a distress signal is detected on a small island in the Pacific, Amuro is dispatched with the Core Fighter to investigate the source.
episodes.title: Cucuruz Doan's Island

episodes.synopsis: Sayla Mass sorties with the Gundam without authorization in the hopes of finding out whether Char Aznable is her long lost brother.
episodes.title: Sayla's Agony

episodes.synopsis: Bright Noa decides to relieve Amuro as pilot of the Gundam after a tactical blunder made by the latter on the field of battle nearly results in defeat.
episodes.title: Amuro Deserts

episodes.synopsis: The crew of White Base searches for the Amuro and the Gundam; Amuro hopes to end the war by attacking a mine believed to be the main source of iron ore for the Zeon war industry.
episodes.title: Zeon's Secret Mine

episodes.synopsis: A mobile suit squadron led by Ramba Ral and his Gouf attack White Base while Amuro and the Gundam return just in time to help.
episodes.title: Ramba Ral's Attack

episodes.synopsis: An all-out battle breaks out inside White Base as Ramba Ral and his soldiers infiltrate the ship in the hopes of capturing or destroying it.
episodes.title: Hand to Hand Combat

episodes.synopsis: Crowley Hamon spearheads one last suicidal attack on White Base with what remains of the troops once led by Ramba Ral.
episodes.title: Sorrow and Hatred

episodes.synopsis: As Operation Odessa nears, Colonel M'Quve lures the White Base into a trap while Bright Noa is unable to captain the ship.
episodes.title: The Trap of M'Quve

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenant Matilda's supply corps is attacked by Zeon Goufs when they attempt to send upgrade modules for the Gundam and supply and repair parts for White Base.
episodes.title: Matilda's Rescue

episodes.synopsis: A mole inside the Federation tips off Zeon HQ, who then send the Black Tri-Stars special team ordered to destroy the White Base and her prototype mobile suits.
episodes.title: Black Tri-Star

episodes.synopsis: Amuro discovers the Zeon mole, stops a nuclear bomb, and faces off the remaining two members of the Black Tri-Stars as the battle at Odessa continues.
episodes.title: The Battle of Odessa

episodes.synopsis: Under the command of Char Aznable, new Zeon amphibious mobile suits attack White Base, docked in a Federation base at Belfast.
episodes.title: Char Returns

episodes.synopsis: Kai Shiden develops a friendship with Miharu Ratokie, a local girl, while Char prepares a second amphibious attack on the Federation at Belfast.
episodes.title: A Spy on Board

episodes.synopsis: Thanks to intelligence acquired from Miharu, Flanagan Boone and his Mad Angler squadron attack the White Base en route to Jaburo headquarters in South America.
episodes.title: Across the Atlantic Ocean

episodes.synopsis: The White Base finally reaches Jaburo general headquarters; Zeon then launches a massive invasion on the base led by Char and his custom Z'Gok.
episodes.title: Tragedy in Jaburo

episodes.synopsis: Char infiltrates Jaburo with a squadron of Acguy mobile suits and plant time bombs on the Federation's new mass-produced GMs, but not before being discovered by Katz, Kikka, and Letz.
episodes.title: A Wish of War Orphans

episodes.synopsis: White Base and the Gundam confront the cruiser Zanzibar, led by Char, and a mobile armor called Bigro in low earth orbit.
episodes.title: A Decoy in Space

episodes.synopsis: A task force of Musai cruisers and Rick Doms led by Dren attempt to destroy the White Base as it heads towards the neutral colony of Side Six.
episodes.title: Breakthrough

episodes.synopsis: In need of repairs, the White Base is attacked outside the neutral Side Six by a fleet led by Captain Coskon.
episodes.title: Farewell in Side Six

episodes.synopsis: Inside Side Six, Amuro meets a beautiful girl named Lalah Sune and tensions run high when a Zanzibar ship led by Char Aznable docks next to the White Base.
episodes.title: A Fateful Encounter

episodes.synopsis: A massive Federation combined space fleet attacks the Principality of Zeon's Fortress of Solomon, commanded by Dozle Zabi.
episodes.title: The Glory of Solomon

episodes.synopsis: As the battle continues, a hulking mobile armor piloted by Dozle Zabi inflicts heavy losses on the Federation; Amuro and Sleggar come up with a plan to stop its onslaught.
episodes.title: Big Zam's Last Stand

episodes.synopsis: Amuro Ray's Gundam duels Colonel M'Quve's Gyan on the abandoned and dilapitated colony of Texas while Char and Lalah watch from afar.
episodes.title: The Duel in Texas

episodes.synopsis: Char Aznable's Gelgoog takes over M'Quve on engaging the Gundam while the White Base enters the Texas colony and sends Sayla Mass and Job John to search for Amuro.
episodes.title: Char and Sayla

episodes.synopsis: Gihren Zabi sends Char a Newtype to pilot the new Braw Bro; Amuro's own Newtype abilities are growing as he senses the presence of Lalah.
episodes.title: The Newtype: Challia Bull

episodes.synopsis: The Gundam is upgraded and Lalah's Elmeth enters combat for the first time; Amuro and Lalah cross paths again but this time as enemies.
episodes.title: Lalah's Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: Amuro and Lalah fight each other for the second time and communicate telepathically, while Gihren Zabi inspects the construction of the Solar Ray.
episodes.title: A Cosmic Glow

episodes.synopsis: Federation forces, including White Base, proceed to invade the Fortress of A Baoa Qu despite losing half of their combined fleet caused by Zeon's Solar Ray; Amuro and Char -now piloting the Zeong- engage in battle again.
episodes.title: Space Fortress: A Baoa Qu

episodes.synopsis: The Battle of A Baoa Qu reaches a critical point; White Base is deep within enemy territory, Amuro and Char's relentless duel continues, and Kycilia Zabi struggles in command.
episodes.title: Escape
